text:
sana: Quick thread to assign tasks for the joint Datadog + HW SI observability pack. Goal: a marketplace-friendly tile with a compact dashboard, OTEL mapping doc, simple collector snippet, and a 90s demo script. Need owners and deadlines.
amar: I can handle the Datadog dashboard JSON and the marketplace packaging. Will aim for a "lite" 3-panel tile + full 8-panel repo dashboard. Need canonical metric names and a couple of trace examples.
sana: Great. Tess can you produce OTLP trace examples and a minimal collector config for SIs?
tess: Yes. I'll include spans: inference.request, model.verify, cache.lookup. Attributes to show: service.name=redwood-inference, deployment.zone, device.gpu_type. Also include batch_size and kv_cache_hit attributes.
amar: KPI set proposal: p50_latency_ms, p95_latency_ms, tokens_per_sec, cache_hit_ratio, gpu_util_pct, errors_per_min. Also want a small cost estimate card: cost_per_1k_tokens with batching vs no-batching.
tess: OTLP sample payload (single line): {"resource":{"service.name":"redwood-inference","device.gpu_type":"H100"},"spans":[{"name":"inference.request","duration_ms":98,"attributes":{"model":"gptx-13b","tokens_in":20,"tokens_out":100,"batch_size":4,"kv_cache_hit":true}}]}
sana: Timeline: demo recording Fri 2025-05-30 09:00 PT. Final assets in repo by Thu EOD; review sync Thu 11:00 PT. Can we hit Thu noon for a PR?
amar: I'll have the lite dashboard JSON by Wed EOD and full dashboard by Thu 9:30. Tess will post trace examples today.
ops-bot: embargo_note: "marketplace embargo until 2025-06-04T00:00:00Z"
qa-bot: smoke-test: sample traces fed into staging dashboard -> traces rendered, metrics mapped :white_check_mark:
sana: Owners recap: Datadog dashboards + packaging = amar, OTLP traces + collector snippet = tess, release coordination + announcement = sana. Action: short sync Wed 10:00 PT to sanity-check panels and demo script. If blockers, ping me in #partnerships. :thumbsup:
